text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will push on toward a key objective at 129.86 on Friday having posted a solid session on Wednesay before a Thursday holiday, technical analysts said.
U.S April payrolls however, may curb trade until later.
"The next retracement objective is 129.86," Brenda Sullivan, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London, said.
Sullivan said 129.86 was the 62 percent retracement of the February to April decline.
June notionnel futures were quoted at 129.50 at 0634 GMT, up 54 basis points from Wednesday.
Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London, said above 129.86 congestion loomed at 130.00.
Sullivan said support this session would come in at 129.38, a 50 percent retracement of the February to April decline. An uptrend line on 30 minute charts comes in this session at 129.11.
Celaya said below there, support would be offered by Wednesday's high at 128.76 while trendline support on daily charts came in at 128.45.
At the short end, June Pibor futures were quoted at 96.44, up two basis points from Wednesday.
Debt markets were fixated on U.S. April payrolls numbers at 1230 GMT, seen at 211,000 versus 175,000 in March.
